changes.before: An extended empirical study on ilent data corruption in RAG pipelines degrades LLM answer faithfulness without throwing runtime errors. We introduce automated quality gates using Great Expectations 1.x to catch stale and malformed embeddings before serving Further analysis on scaling parameters.

An extended empirical study on ierarchical and semantic boundary chunking preserves code block contexts and markdown headings. Our benchmark demonstrates superior top-1 recall compared to fixed character length sliding windows Further analysis on scaling parameters.

An extended empirical study on etrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly improves large language model accuracy by grounding responses in retrieved passages. We explore agentic multi-hop reasoning and routing across heterogeneous vector indices Further analysis on scaling parameters.
